assessment.basis: All eleven machine-readable comparison series enter one shared Equation (20) objective against the mean Table 2 Holzapfel and Table 3 Vinet isotherm. Table 4 is retained as a post-calibration closure test. The calculation cannot recover the eleven EOS parameter sets independently because the source omits complete thermochemical/ultrasonic rows, weights, and covariance.

fit.objective: minimize the sum over markers of the mean squared residual between Equation (20) and the pointwise mean of the Table 2 Holzapfel and Table 3 Vinet pressures, so each of the eleven markers has equal total weight

assessment.basis: Agreement within the source's reported parameter error widths; this is not an inferred confidence convention.
qualifications: Every compared free central value lies inside its printed source error width, with finite reconstructed standard errors under the explicit conditional error model. This is numerical parameter parity, not a formal source-confidence test or recovery of author workflow. Equal weights on the original pressure residuals; observed volumes and fixed coefficients conditioned on. Earlier audit statement (superseded only as to missing reconstruction uncertainty and the resulting numerical label): Complete source rows for this material are bundled and the dedicated two-ruby-scale refit recovers every coefficient within the published 95% interval. The common ledger classifies the result as similar, not strict parity, because the dedicated audit does not infer a refit covariance from rounded source rows. See docs/literature-reproductions/uncertainty-reconstruction.md for the complete conditional uncertainty budget.

assumptions: Equal weights on the original pressure residuals; observed volumes and fixed coefficients conditioned on.
Local standard errors condition on the recorded row selection, fixed/adopted parameters and pressure-coordinate reduction; calibration systematics and cross-row correlations are not propagated.
Residual-scaled estimates assume independent residuals with common variance after any frozen weighting. They are not published parameter uncertainties or a recovered author error budget.
Student-t intervals, where supplied, are marginal local approximations, not exact nonlinear or joint confidence regions.
Source error confidence is retained as reported (including Dewaele's 95% intervals); missing confidence remains unknown and no new combined-two-sigma flag is inferred.
